26:       }
27:     }
28: 
29:     // 如果需要认证，添加认证头
30:     if (requiresAuth) {
31:       const userStore = useUserStore()
32:       if (!userStore.isLoggedIn) {
33:         throw new Error('用户未登录')
34:       }
35: 
36:       Object.assign(requestOptions.headers, userStore.getAuthHeaders())
37:     }
38: 
39:     // 发送请求
40:     const response = await fetch(url, requestOptions)
41: 
42:     // 处理API返回的错误
43:     if (!response.ok) {
44:       // 尝试解析错误信息
45:       let errorMessage = `请求失败: ${response.status}, ${response.statusText}`
46:       let errorData = null
47: 
48:       console.log('API请求失败:', {
49:         url,
50:         status: response.status,
51:         statusText: response.statusText,
52:         headers: Object.fromEntries(response.headers.entries())
53:       })
54: 
55:       try {
56:         errorData = await response.json()
57:         // detail 可能是字符串，也可能是结构化对象（如 { error, message }），后者需取出可读文案，
58:         // 否则直接拼接会得到 "[object Object]"。
59:         const detail = errorData.detail
60:         if (detail && typeof detail === 'object') {
61:           errorMessage = detail.message || detail.error || errorMessage
62:         } else {
63:           errorMessage = detail || errorData.message || errorMessage
64:         }
65:         console.log('API错误详情:', errorData)
66: 
67:         // 如果是422错误，打印更详细的信息
68:         if (response.status === 422) {
69:           console.error('422验证错误详情:', {
70:             url,
71:             requestMethod: requestOptions.method,
72:             requestHeaders: requestOptions.headers,
73:             requestBody: requestOptions.body,
74:             responseData: errorData
75:           })
76:         }
77:       } catch (e) {
78:         // 如果无法解析JSON，使用默认错误信息
79:         console.log('无法解析错误响应JSON:', e)
80:       }
81: 
82:       // 特殊处理401和403错误
83:       const error = new Error(errorMessage)
84:       error.response = {
85:         status: response.status,
86:         statusText: response.statusText,
87:         data: errorData
88:       }
89: 
90:       if (response.status === 401) {
91:         // 如果是认证失败，可能需要重新登录
92:         const userStore = useUserStore()
93: 
94:         // 检查是否是token过期（errorMessage 已统一为字符串，避免对对象 detail 调用 includes 抛错）
95:         const isTokenExpired =
96:           errorMessage?.includes('令牌已过期') || errorMessage?.includes('token expired')
97: 
98:         message.error(isTokenExpired ? '登录已过期，请重新登录' : '认证失败，请重新登录')
99: 
100:         // 如果用户当前认为自己已登录，则登出
101:         if (userStore.isLoggedIn) {
102:           userStore.logout()
103:         }
104: 
105:         // 使用setTimeout确保消息显示后再跳转
106:         setTimeout(() => {
107:           window.location.href = '/login'
108:         }, 1500)
109: 
110:         throw error
111:       } else if (response.status === 403) {
112:         error.message = '没有权限执行此操作'
113:         throw error
114:       } else if (response.status === 500) {
115:         error.message = '服务器内部错误，请使用 docker logs api-dev 查看详细日志'
116:         throw error
117:       }
118: 
119:       throw error
120:     }
121: 
122:     // 根据responseType处理响应
123:     if (responseType === 'blob') {
124:       return response
125:     } else if (responseType === 'json') {
126:       // 检查Content-Type以确定如何处理响应
127:       const contentType = response.headers.get('Content-Type')
128:       if (contentType && contentType.includes('application/json')) {
129:         return await response.json()
130:       }
131:       return await response.text()
132:     } else if (responseType === 'text') {
133:       return await response.text()
134:     } else {
135:       return response
136:     }
137:   } catch (error) {
138:     if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
139:       console.error('API请求错误:', error)
140:     }
141:     throw error
